quest_cargo_desc: Hook the trailer to the truck, leave it in Paleto Bay and bring the truck back.
quest_boxes_desc: Drive the van up to Vinewood Hills and load four boxes.
quest_trash_desc: Drive to the bulldozer and wreck an old car with it.
quest_clean_desc: Brush, blow and clean nine spots down the stairs.
dialog_cargo_1: Hello! Get in the truck and hook up the trailer.
dialog_cargo_2: Then look at the GPS, it shows where the trailer goes.
dialog_cargo_3: Leave the trailer there and bring the truck back here.
dialog_boxes_1: Well! Get in the van behind you.
dialog_boxes_2: Then look at the GPS, it shows where to go.
dialog_boxes_3: When you get there, put the boxes in the van.
dialog_trash_1: Well! Get in the car behind you.
dialog_trash_2: Then look at the GPS, it shows where the bulldozer is.
dialog_trash_3: Take the bulldozer and wreck the old car with it.
dialog_clean_1: Well! Run down the stairs behind you.
dialog_clean_2: Then look at the map, it shows the area to clean.
dialog_clean_3: Clean every spot in the area until you are told you are done.
hint_return: Bring %s back to the marked position and leave it
hint_ped: Go back to %s for your reward
need_trailer: You need to have %s hooked up.
delivered: You delivered %s. Now bring the truck back.
dropped_box: You dropped the box. Pick it up again.
all_done: Well done, come back to %s for your reward.
rewarded: You got $%s in reward, welcome back!
not_finished_content: You haven't finished the job yet. Do you want to cancel it?

quest_busy: Someone else is doing this job. Come back later.
cooldown: Wait %s minutes before you take this job again.
not_carrying: You are not carrying a box.
not_done: You haven't finished the job yet.
